newsitem.title: UK: Pilkington to build Poland car glass plant.
newsitem.headline: Pilkington to build Poland car glass plant.

text.p: British glass and plastic products manufacturer Pilkington Plc said on Tuesday it would build a 20 million stg automotive glass toughening plant in southern Poland.
Pilkington said work on the new plant in Sandomierz would start immediately and was expected to be completed by summer 1998.
Pilkington said the new factory would employ 200 people initially, rising later to more than 300. The new plant will be sited next to Pilkington's existing float glass plant.

Pilkington said Poland was Europe's fastest-growing car market last year. It said it produced laminated windscreens for Daewoo Group, Fiat SpA, General Motors Corp and Ford Motor Co who have factories in Poland.
It said the new plant would be built by local contractors and the machinery would be imported.
